summary: Tested MRP Reserve/Unreserve functionality. All 7 features verified working: reserve endpoint, unreserve endpoint, MRP demand only shows RM items, reserved_for_mo column, net calculation formula, Reserve/Unreserve buttons on MO page, Reserved badge.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/work-orders/{wo_id}/reserve - creates reserved_materials array with all BOM items (RM, SA, CP)
Backend: POST /api/work-orders/{wo_id}/unreserve - removes reservation, sets materials_reserved=false
Backend: GET /api/mrp/demand - returns ONLY raw_material category items
Backend: MRP demand includes reserved_for_mo field showing total reserved qty across all MOs
Backend: MRP net calculation: net = gross_req - max(on_hand - reserved_for_mo - safety_stock, 0) - verified correct
Backend: Cannot reserve already reserved MO - returns 400 error
Backend: GET /api/mrp/suggestions - returns ONLY raw_material category items
Frontend MO page: Pending MOs show 'Reserve' button (data-testid='reserve-wo-{id}')
Frontend MO page: Reserved MOs show 'Reserved' badge and 'Unreserve' button
Frontend MO page: After unreserve, 'Reserve' button appears again
Frontend MRP page: Demand table has 'Reserved (MO)' column showing reserved_for_mo value
Frontend MRP page: Reserved values highlighted in orange/yellow color
Frontend MRP page: Only raw_material items shown (RM-001, RM-002), no SA/CP items
critical_code_review_comments: Reserve endpoint correctly explodes BOM recursively and stores ALL materials (RM, SA, CP) in reserved_materials array
MRP demand correctly filters to only show raw_material category items
MRP aggregates reserved quantities from all MOs with materials_reserved=True and status in ['pending', 'in_progress']
Net calculation formula correctly implemented: net = gross - max(available, 0) where available = on_hand - reserved - safety
seed_data_creation: Created SO-000003 (qty=2, confirmed) and MO-000002 (pending) for FG-001 to test reserve flow. MO-000002 was reserved and unreserved during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MRP Reserve/Unreserve feature fully tested and working. Test data: SO-000003 (confirmed), MO-000002 (pending, unreserved). MRP shows 2 RM items with demand. Reserve flow: create pending MO -> reserve -> MRP shows reserved_for_mo -> unreserve -> reserved_for_mo becomes 0.

reserve_endpoint.details: POST /api/work-orders/{wo_id}/reserve creates reserved_materials array with 8 items (RM-001, RM-002, RM-003, SA-001, SA-002, CP-001, CP-002, CP-003)

unreserve_endpoint.details: POST /api/work-orders/{wo_id}/unreserve removes reservation, sets materials_reserved=false and clears reserved_materials array

mrp_demand_rm_only.details: GET /api/mrp/demand returns only raw_material category items (RM-001, RM-002), not SA or CP items

mrp_reserved_for_mo_field.details: MRP demand response includes reserved_for_mo field showing total reserved qty across all MOs

mrp_net_calculation.details: Formula: net = gross_req - max(on_hand - reserved_for_mo - safety_stock, 0). Verified with RM-001: 30 = 30 - max(28-20-50, 0)

frontend_reserve_button.details: Pending MOs show 'Reserve' button with data-testid='reserve-wo-{id}'

frontend_reserved_badge.details: Reserved MOs show green 'Reserved' badge next to status and 'Unreserve' button

frontend_mrp_reserved_column.details: MRP demand table has 'Reserved (MO)' column header with values highlighted in orange/yellow

mrp_suggestions_rm_only.details: GET /api/mrp/suggestions returns only raw_material category items
